key_findings: The mind-monkey curve's 6 stages: indulgence→suppression→awakening; the Six-Eared Macaque is the key turning point
The 81 hardships map to 8 Buddhist mind-nature trials, with anger the most frequent (15 times)
The Cultivation Allegory Map reveals Xiyouji to be a 'mind-nature cultivation allegory', not an adventure story
The Heart Sutra (taught in Ch. 19) is the book's intellectual through-line
philosophical_core: The philosophical essence of Xiyouji is 'mind-nature cultivation': breaking through greed, anger, ignorance, pride, and doubt via the 81 hardships to return to the original mind
